[LGRA.22.6] **Qualified constant references.** A library-qualified constant
reference in expression position is spelled `p.NAME` (`lib.CONST`,
`config.limits.MAX_TEMP`), as a qualified schema is ([LGRA.22.4]), and is available
once the library is imported ([LIMP.1]); it needs no **selective**
`from lib import CONST`. In expression position a dotted name may also be slot
access, so the compiler resolves it by scope ([LGRA.22.9]).
